author: Numberz_
body:
Hello! About two years ago I released a map called Retro, which was a DTM map with NES controllers and T.V.'s as the bases. I recently found the file for the map on my computer and decided to edit and resubmit it. The idea has stayed the same but the design and island/space has been improved greatly.



Original thread: https://avicus.net/forums/1f32ee2ca

ADDED-
-Lots of space for tunneling!
-More islands (NES system & game cartridges)
-Diamonds!
-Larger amounts of iron
-Spawn chests with defense supplies
-Different monument configuration with bedrock

Creator: 99250
Helper: DKingwhite

YAML: http://pastebin.com/10N1zQq0 (*MAY HAVE SOME ERRORS FIRST TIME MAKING ONE*).
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/z61cvv9gv2b7px1/Retro_2.1_DTM.zip
Album: http://imgur.com/a/wd30D

Feedback is appreciated!

I find that the islands are placed in really weird locations, that I don't really understand. I feel like numerous changes could be made to this map, but I'd be interested in how this map plays.

replies.author: Numberz_
replies.body:
The islands on the side are there to provide another a bridging route, although they are kinda out of the way they have supplies (diamonds) hidden inside. Giving players a reason to go over there.

I added a lot of space for tunneling, and the monuments are in a location similar to Castle Adventure, where you could easily break them from the sides/top. The sides of the main base/T.V. is good for wall running.

I don't understand what you mean by more open?

Thanks for the feedback though! I really appreciate it.
